title: Ralph Deitch

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
CONFIDENTIAL REPORT
（批：860 9 6 -41）
S. 1. Special Branch Station. File No.................... Date June 9, 1941.
SUBJECT: Ralph DEITCH
Ralph DEITCH, 46, is a naturalised British subject of Lithuanian origin. He was born in Kovno, Russia, in 1895 and came to Shanghai from Australia in 1932.
Ralph Deitch is the proprietor of the British Manufacturing Co., Wholesale and Retail Manufacturers of Raincoats and Leather Coats, 795 Bubbling Well Road. He resides with his wife and members of his staff at Flat A.1, 651 Weihaiwei Road.
Enquiries by members of the Special Branch reveal that R. Deitch is well respected in his circle of business and social acquaintances. He is understood to live a quiet life and there is no reason to show that his business is anything but profitable.
R. Deitch is known to have considerable business dealings with various Japanese interests and it can be safely assumed that the raw material necessary in his manufacturing concern emanates from Japan.
There is nothing in Shanghai Municipal Police records to the detriment of Ralph Deitch.
12/9/4.
A.C. (Special Branch)
（签名）
D. S. I.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
机密报告
（批：860 9 6 -41）
S. 1. 特别股分站。档案号.................... 日期 1941年6月9日。
事由：拉尔夫·戴奇（Ralph DEITCH）
拉尔夫·戴奇，46岁，系立陶宛裔归化英国臣民。他于1895年生于俄国科夫诺（Kovno），1932年从澳大利亚来到上海。
拉尔夫·戴奇是位于静安寺路795号的“英国制造公司”（British Manufacturing Co.）的业主，该公司从事雨衣和皮衣的批发与零售制造业务。他与妻子及职员居住在威海卫路651号A.1室公寓。
特别股成员的调查显示，R. 戴奇在其商业和社交圈中颇受尊重。据悉他生活低调，且没有理由表明其生意不盈利。
已知 R. 戴奇与各方日本利益集团有大量的商业往来，可以稳妥地推断，其制造企业所需的原材料来自日本。
在上海公共租界工部局警务处的记录中，没有任何对拉尔夫·戴奇不利的记载。
1941年9月12日。
助理总监（特别股）
（签名）
副督察长。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
SP. BR. REGISTRY
BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL
No. N. 860 SHANGHAI
May 19th 1945
20/5/1945 letter form

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that His
Majesty's Consul-General has received a letter from
the Secretary, Department of the Interior, Australia,
in which certain information is sought regarding
Mr. Ralph Deitch, a British subject by naturalization
of Lithuanian origin, who is resident at 795,
Bubbling Well Road, Shanghai.

His Majesty's Consul-General has been requested
to ascertain how long Mr. Deitch has been living
out of the British Empire since he left Australia
and when he proposes to return to Australia or to
take up residence in some other British territory.

For your information I would state that under
the Commonwealth Nationality Law consideration may
be given to the question of revoking a certificate
of naturalization in any case where a person to whom
a certificate has been granted has been absent from
British territory for a period of not less than
seven years since the date of the grant, otherwise
than as a representative of a British subject, firm,
or company, carrying on business, or an institution
established, in His Majesty's Dominions, or in
the service of the Crown, and has not maintained
substantial connection with His Majesty's Dominions.

According to the records of this office Mr.
Deitch has registered as a British subject here
continuously since 1932 and it would therefore
appear that Shanghai can be regarded as his
permanent place of residence. It will be necessary
for me to ask Mr. Deitch to visit this Consulate-
General so that I can make enquiries regarding his
possible intention to return to Australia or else-
where, but, before I do so, I shall be grateful
/for

The Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council,
SHANGHAI.

先生，

谨此告知，英王陛下总领事已收到澳大利亚内政部秘书的来信，信中寻求关于拉尔夫·戴奇先生的某些信息。戴奇先生系立陶宛裔归化英国臣民，居住于上海静安寺路795号。

英王陛下总领事被要求查明，戴奇先生自离开澳大利亚以来，有多长时间未居住在大英帝国境内，以及他打算何时返回澳大利亚或迁居至其他英国领土。

供贵方参考，兹说明根据《英联邦国籍法》，若获颁归化证书之人，自发证之日起，除作为在大英帝国领地内经营业务的英国臣民、商号或公司的代表，或作为在英王陛下领地内设立的机构之代表，或服务于王室之外，已离开英国领土不少于七年，且未与英王陛下领地保持实质性联系，则可能会考虑撤销其归化证书的问题。

根据本处记录，戴先生自1932年以来一直在此注册为英国臣民，因此上海似乎可被视为其永久居住地。我有必要请戴先生前来本总领事馆，以便我就其可能返回澳大利亚或其他地方的意图进行查询，但在这样做之前，如蒙
